item.title: New Volvo FH16 780 is Just the Job
item.description: GF Job has continued its transition to Volvo Trucks with the arrival of a new range- topping Volvo FH16 780 Globetrotter XL 6×4 150-tonne tractor unit.

item.title: Nooteboom Introduces EURO-PX3
item.description: In April, Nooteboom proudly introduced the new EURO-PX3, the 3rd generation EURO-PX low loaders with pendle axles.
